title: Search initialization
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define the initial search state as the pair encoding of the increment of the first component of the output of the doubling loop on $z$, and the pair encoding of $[\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}]$ with $[\mathrm{false}]$.
caveat: The pair encoding, pair decomposition, increment operation, and doubling loop are not defined in the supplied material.
